    t.product_category_name_english AS categoria,
    SUM(oi.price) AS ingresos,

ORDER BY ingresos_promedio DESC

  SELECT v.customer_state, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gasto_total
  FROM vw_pedidos_validos v
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = v.order_id
  GROUP BY v.customer_state
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
),
max_gasto AS (
  SELECT MAX(gasto_total) AS max_gasto
  FROM pedidos_estado
)
SELECT customer_state, gasto_total
FROM pedidos_estado
WHERE gasto_total = (SELECT max_gasto FROM max_gasto)
